purpose: Build an image from a Dockerfile + context. Since Docker Engine 23.0, `docker build` uses Buildx + BuildKit by default (was the legacy builder). Aliases: `docker image build`. Source PATH (local), URL (git), `-` (stdin Dockerfile).

flags.name: --build-arg
flags.doc: Set ARG value. Without `=VAL`, inherits from caller's env. Repeatable.

flags.name: --platform
flags.doc: Target platform(s). Multi-platform requires --output type that supports manifest lists.

flags.name: --cache-from
flags.doc: Import cache. Forms: type=registry,ref=<image> | type=local,src=<path> | type=gha | type=s3,...,bucket=... | type=azblob,...

flags.name: --cache-to
flags.doc: Export cache. Same forms; mode=max captures all layers, mode=min only final.

flags.name: -o, --output
flags.doc: Output destination. type=image (default), type=local,dest=<dir>, type=tar,dest=- , type=registry, type=docker, type=oci.

flags.name: --load
flags.doc: Shorthand for --output=type=docker (load into local image store). Mutually exclusive with --push for multi-platform.

flags.name: --ssh
flags.doc: SSH agent for `RUN --mount=type=ssh`. `default` uses host's SSH agent.

flags.name: --metadata-file
flags.doc: Write build metadata (digest, ref) as JSON.

flags.name: --progress
flags.doc: Progress format. plain is the right choice for CI logs.

examples.expected_output: BuildKit builds and tags myapp:1.0 in the local image store
multi-arch manifest list pushed to registry
build with NPM_TOKEN available via RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npm_token
examples.scenario: private-registry npm install without leaking the token in image history

purpose: Same surface as `docker build` (since 23.0 they're aliases) but explicitly invokes the buildx CLI. Use directly when you want to be sure you're getting the buildx behavior, or when running a non-default builder via `--builder`.

flags.name: --platform
flags.doc: Target platform(s). With multiple, requires --push or --output type=oci/local — can't --load multi-platform.

flags.name: --push
flags.doc: Push to registry. Required for multi-platform.

flags.name: --load
flags.doc: Load into local image store. Single-platform only.

flags.name: --build-context
flags.doc: Additional named context. e.g. `--build-context shared=../shared` for `COPY --from=shared`.

flags.name: --no-cache-filter
flags.doc: Disable cache for specific stages only.

flags.name: -o, --output
flags.doc: Output destination. Multi-platform supported types: registry, oci, local.

flags.name: --invoke
flags.doc: Drop into an interactive command after a failed build (debug experimental).

flags.name: --call
flags.doc: Inspect the build graph: check (validate), outline (list ARG/INSTR), targets (list stages).

examples.invocation: docker buildx build --builder mybuilder --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --push -t myreg/myapp:1 .
examples.expected_output: multi-arch image pushed; manifest list created
list of stages, ARGs, ENVs in the Dockerfile

purpose: Create a buildx builder instance. Combined with `--use`, it becomes the active builder for subsequent `docker build` / `docker buildx build` commands.

flags.name: --use
flags.doc: Switch to this builder after creating.

flags.name: --bootstrap
flags.doc: Boot the builder immediately (vs lazy on first build).

flags.name: --node
flags.doc: Node name within a builder (multi-node setups).

flags.name: --append
flags.doc: Append a node to an existing builder.

flags.name: --buildkitd-flags
flags.doc: Extra flags to pass to buildkitd in this builder.

examples.scenario: set up a docker-container builder for advanced features
point at a shared remote BuildKit instance

purpose: Switch the active builder. Persists across shell sessions (per `docker context`).

flags.name: --default
flags.doc: Set as default for the current docker context.

flags.name: --global
flags.doc: Set as default across all contexts.

purpose: Build a matrix of targets defined in HCL/JSON/Compose files. Each target is a separate image. Variables, groups, and target overrides supported. The CI driver for monorepo / multi-image builds.

flags.name: -f, --file
flags.doc: Bake file. Repeatable. Default search: docker-bake.hcl, docker-bake.json, compose.yaml, docker-compose.yml.

flags.name: --print
flags.doc: Show the resolved build matrix without building.

flags.name: --pull
flags.doc: Pull base images for all targets.

flags.name: --load
flags.doc: Load all built images locally (single-platform per target).

examples.expected_output: JSON of the resolved build matrix

examples.scenario: build a subset of bake targets

examples.expected_output: api built with overridden tag, loaded locally
examples.scenario: dev workflow with one-off tag override

purpose: Create or modify an image manifest list (multi-arch image) on a registry from existing single-arch images. Doesn't rebuild — just stitches. Companion: `imagetools inspect <ref>` to view a manifest list.

flags.name: -t, --tag
flags.doc: Tag the resulting manifest list. Repeatable.

flags.name: --append
flags.doc: Append to an existing manifest list.

flags.name: -f, --file
flags.doc: Read sources from a file (one ref per line).

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.doc: Print the manifest list without pushing.

flags.name: --prefer-index
flags.doc: Prefer creating an OCI image-index even when sources are individual manifests.

examples.invocation: docker buildx imagetools create -t myreg/myapp:1 myreg/myapp:1-amd64 myreg/myapp:1-arm64
examples.expected_output: manifest list pushed combining the two single-arch tags
examples.scenario: build per-arch separately, stitch into one tag at the end

purpose: Native BuildKit CLI. Works against the buildkitd daemon directly via gRPC. For debugging buildkitd, running standalone BuildKit (without docker), or driving builds with non-Dockerfile frontends. Subcommands: build, debug, prune, du.

flags.name: --tlscacert
flags.doc: CA cert when buildkitd uses TLS.

flags.name: --frontend
flags.doc: Frontend to use (subcommand: build). e.g. `--frontend dockerfile.v0`.

flags.name: --local
flags.doc: Local source dir. e.g. `--local context=. --local dockerfile=.`.

examples.invocation: buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=. --local dockerfile=. --output type=image,name=myapp:1,push=true
examples.expected_output: BuildKit builds the Dockerfile and pushes

examples.scenario: figure out what's filling the buildkitd cache

examples.expected_output: prunes cache entries unused for >7 days

purpose: BuildKit daemon. gRPC server on `/run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock` by default. Two worker backends: OCI (runc; default) and containerd. Reads `/etc/buildkit/buildkitd.toml`.

flags.name: --containerd-worker-addr
flags.doc: containerd socket when using containerd worker.

examples.invocation: sudo buildkitd --addr tcp://0.0.0.0:1234 --tlscacert ca.pem --tlscert cert.pem --tlskey key.pem
examples.expected_output: buildkitd listens on TCP with mTLS
rootless buildkitd starts under unprivileged userns
